result.topic_en: A German historical narrative, not mathematics: Pelopidas defeats Alexander of Pherae, takes Larissa, brings the young Philip of Macedon to Thebes as a hostage, and is later imprisoned by Alexander, after which Thebes sends a second army in which Epaminondas serves as a common soldier.
